sections.title: AI Services for Chicago Media Organizations
sections.description: Custom AI solutions built for Chicago's media, publishing, broadcasting, and advertising sector.

blocks.heading: Local News and Publishing AI
paragraphs: For Chicago's news organizations — Chicago Tribune, Chicago Sun-Times, Crain's Chicago Business, and the digital news ecosystem:

Automated local reporting: NLP generating structured story drafts from Chicago city data — crime statistics, building permits, court filings, city council votes, and financial disclosures — enabling Chicago newsrooms to cover data-driven stories at the volume that manual reporting can't match.
Archive and research intelligence: RAG over decades of Chicago Tribune and Sun-Times archives enabling journalists to query Chicago's deep institutional knowledge in natural language.
Subscription and reader analytics: ML predicting Chicago reader subscription conversion, churn risk, and content engagement to optimize newsletter and subscription acquisition.
Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Broadcast Media and Streaming Analytics
paragraphs: For WGN, WGN-TV (now Nexstar), WTTW (Chicago's PBS station), and Chicago's radio and podcast community:
Audience analytics: ML for broadcast audience prediction, show performance forecasting, and daypart optimization for Chicago radio and television.
Content performance prediction: ML predicting which content types and topics drive Chicago audience engagement across broadcast and streaming channels.
Podcast and digital audio analytics: Listener behavior ML for Chicago's significant podcast community — episode completion prediction, subscriber conversion, and audience growth modeling.
Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks

blocks.heading: Advertising and Agency AI
paragraphs: Chicago's advertising ecosystem — Publicis (major Chicago office), Foote, Cone & Belding (FCB, Chicago heritage), Leo Burnett (Chicago heritage), and dozens of Chicago advertising agencies and marketing technology companies:
First-party audience AI: ML-powered audience segmentation from Chicago brand first-party data — building predictive audience segments for cookie-independent advertising targeting.
Campaign performance prediction: ML forecasting campaign reach, frequency, and conversion for Chicago advertising planning teams.
Creative performance analytics: NLP and vision AI analyzing which creative elements drive performance across Chicago's advertising market — informing creative strategy with data.
Cost: $35,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Sports Media Analytics
paragraphs: Chicago's extraordinary sports market — Cubs, White Sox, Bears, Bulls, Blackhawks, and the Chicago Fire — creates distinctive sports media analytics AI demand:
Sports content recommendation: ML for sports content recommendation across Chicago's sports media properties — matching fans to relevant content from multiple teams and sports.
Fan engagement prediction: Audience behavior analytics predicting game attendance, merchandise purchasing, and engagement channel preferences for Chicago's major sports franchises.
Sports betting analytics content: NLP and ML for sports analytics content supporting Chicago's legalized sports betting market (Illinois legalized sports betting in 2020).
Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks
